visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit outdoor environment at night, a woman with a pink cap and a striped sweater sits in a black camping chair. A man in grey clothes kneels beside her, holding a wooden block on a flat surface. He guides her hand as she attempts to split the wood with a small axe. A yellow tent is visible behind them under the dark sky. (2) The woman raises the axe and strikes the wooden block successfully, splitting it into two pieces. She reacts with a joyful expression, opening her mouth wide in a laugh. She holds up the two freshly split wooden planks in both hands, showing them to the camera. The man points at her, sharing in the excitement while several other people are partially visible in the shadows. (3) The scene shifts to a closer shot where the woman is carefully writing on one of the wooden planks with a white marker. She is focused on her task, leaning forward slightly. The man is crouching next to her, looking on and occasionally gesturing towards the wood. The lighting is warm and focused on their activity, highlighting the texture of the wood and her movements. (4) The man takes the signed wooden plank and holds it close to the camera lens. His face is beaming with a wide smile, showing his teeth. The signatures and drawings on the wood are clearly visible in the foreground. In the background, the woman continues to smile and wave, her figure slightly out of focus but her joyful expression still apparent.

(6) [Subtitle]: 哦，這簽名的木頭回去不能燒要供著哦?! (7) [Subtitle]: 要供著，哈哈，怪怪的. (8) [Slogan]: 下方留言觀看影片言來抽簽名. [Subtitle]: 謝謝謝謝謝謝耶.
